pattern_explanation: The Ukrainian words in this card look like English words but have taken on different meanings, so the match depends on learning the Ukrainian meanings directly.
false_friend_warning: The Ukrainian word батарея means a radiator, not a battery; мармелад means fruit jelly sweets, not marmalade, which is a citrus jam; and кабінет means an office or study, not a cabinet of furniture; learners who trust the similar spelling will choose the wrong English word.
